data.name: Nehita
data.gender_notes: Nehita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nehita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Neha', which means 'mind' or 'heart'. The suffix '-ita' denotes the one who embodies or possesses the qualities described by the prefix. Thus, Nehita is the one who embodies the nectar of the gods, symbolizing divine grace and spiritual purity. The name Nehita carries the meaning “Nectar of the Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nehita usually hope their child will grow to embody nectar of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Nehita belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Nectar of the Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nehita total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

Therefore, the name Nehita may be perceived as a reminder of the importance of maintaining a pure heart and mind.
